thread:
rachel: quick usability check: when you pin a version in the compare table the keyboard focus jumps out of the panel. reproducible on Chrome and Safari.

devin: steps?

rachel: open catalog, pick 2 models, Compare, press Pin on the left model row. focus goes to address bar area sometimes.

pat: sounds like we're reparenting the row node. are we actually moving the DOM?

devin: yes, we `table.prepend(row)` to group pinned rows. that was simpler for styles but breaks `document.activeElement`.

kim: design preference = stable DOM + visual grouping. two options: CSS sticky/transform, or render a visual-only clone anchored at top. clones must be inert (`aria-hidden` + `tabindex=-1`).

a11y-bot: moving interactive elements causes SR focus loss. suggest announcing "Pinned: vX.Y" in a single polite live region and avoid removing the interactive node.

pat: engineering plan: prototype CSS sticky for pinned rows so DOM stays in place, add `role=status` live text on toggle, and ensure tooltip portals mount to body so perf badge tooltips don't get clipped.

rachel: nice. can we also shorten the button copy? current "Pin version" confuses people. proposal: button = "Pin" + tooltip "Pin 14 Keep this version visible in compares".

kim: approved. will update spec and include an accessibility checklist for the PR.

devin: i'll open a branch and tag @rachel for QA once ready.
